reply.headline: Typical weather in Kolkata, India on 15 Jan 2022.
why: The deciding check was recent rain: 17 mm fell over the 6-day total, and 16.8 mm of it came in the 5 days before.
Days with this much recent rain happen about 29 times a year here now, about as common here as in 1951–1980.
Normal wind for here (gusts up to 24 km/h), and normal highs for here (feels like up to 24 °C).
